blocks.text: OrbitAvanya Tech LLP is pleased to submit this proposal in response to Solicitation **N0038326QPB92** for **IT Services** issued by the **Issuing Agency**. As a prime contractor specializing in enterprise software development, cloud-native architectures, AI/ML systems, and e-Governance digital transformation, OrbitAvanya brings a proven track record of delivering mission-critical technology solutions that align with federal standards for security, scalability, and compliance. Our team understands that this engagement requires not only technical excellence but also rigorous adherence to federal acquisition regulations, cybersecurity frameworks (including **NIST 800-53**, **FISMA**, and **FedRAMP** baselines), and the operational realities of government IT environments. We propose a comprehensive, phased approach encompassing application modernization, cloud migration and optimization, DevSecOps pipeline implementation, data platform engineering, and ongoing managed services — all governed by a robust program management framework compliant with **Earned Value Management (EVM)** and **Agile/SAFe** methodologies. OrbitAvanya's proposed solution leverages our deep expertise in **React/Next.js**, **Python/FastAPI**, **Node.js**, **PostgreSQL**, **MongoDB**, and **AWS GovCloud** to deliver secure, resilient, and user-centric systems. Our commitment to **Zero Trust Architecture**, continuous Authority to Operate (cATO) enablement, and **Section 508** accessibility compliance ensures that every deliverable meets the highest federal standards. With a dedicated team of cleared personnel, CMMI-DEV Level 3 aligned processes, and a past performance portfolio spanning DoD, civilian agency, and intelligence community clients, OrbitAvanya is uniquely positioned to execute this requirement with low risk, high velocity, and full transparency.

blocks.text: The Issuing Agency's requirement for **IT Services** under NAICS **541511** reflects a strategic imperative to modernize legacy systems, accelerate cloud adoption, and strengthen cybersecurity posture across the enterprise. Federal agencies today face converging mandates: **OMB M-22-09** (Zero Trust), **EO 14028** (Improving the Nation's Cybersecurity), **FITARA** scorecard accountability, and the **Federal Data Strategy** — all while delivering citizen-centric digital services under **21st Century IDEA**. This solicitation represents an opportunity to consolidate disparate development, operations, and security functions under a single, accountable prime integrator capable of end-to-end delivery. OrbitAvanya recognizes that success requires more than technical execution; it demands a partner who speaks the language of **A&A packages**, **POA&M management**, **FedRAMP authorization**, and **ITIL/ITSM** service management. Our approach is architected from the ground up to satisfy these cross-cutting requirements while delivering measurable mission outcomes: reduced **Mean Time to Deploy (MTTD)**, improved **System Availability (>99.9%)**, accelerated **Authority to Operate (ATO)** timelines, and quantifiable **cost avoidance** through cloud optimization and license rationalization.
Finding 1 · Legacy Application Modernization Imperative

Analysis of typical federal IT portfolios under this NAICS code reveals a high prevalence of monolithic **Java/.NET Framework** applications running on-premises or in **IL-2/IL-4** environments, accumulating technical debt and posing **CVE** exposure risks. These systems often lack **API-first** architectures, **containerization**, and **observability** — inhibiting scaling, security patching, and integration with modern identity fabrics (e.g., **Entra ID**, **Login.gov**, **CAC/PIV**).

items: **68%** of federal applications are >10 years old (GAO-23-105831)
**Containerization** and **microservices** reduce patch cycles from months to days
**API gateway** adoption enables **Zero Trust** segmentation and **Least Privilege** access
**Strangler Fig** pattern minimizes mission disruption during incremental migration

blocks.text: Finding 2 · Cloud Migration & Optimization Gap

Agencies frequently achieve initial **Cloud Smart** migration but stall at optimization, resulting in **30-45% waste** (Flexera 2024 State of Cloud Report). Missing capabilities include: **FinOps** governance, **rightsizing automation**, **reserved instance/savings plan** management, **multi-account landing zone** governance (**AWS Control Tower** / **Azure Landing Zones**), and **drift detection** via **IaC** (**Terraform**, **CloudFormation**).

items: **FinOps Foundation** certified practitioners reduce spend **20-35%** Year 1
**Landing zones** accelerate new workload onboarding from weeks to hours

blocks.text: Finding 3 · DevSecOps Maturity Deficit

Most federal development pipelines remain **CI-only** with manual security gates, lengthy **STIG** application, and no **cATO** pathway. Critical gaps: **SAST/DAST/SCA/container scanning** integration, **policy-as-code** (**OPA/Rego**), **automated STIG/CCI mapping**, **chaos engineering**, and **deployment strategies** (**Blue/Green**, **Canary**) for zero-downtime releases.
Finding 4 · Data Platform & AI/ML Readiness

Agencies possess vast structured/unstructured data but lack **modern data platforms** supporting **Data Mesh**, **Lakehouse** (**Delta Lake**, **Iceberg**), **real-time streaming** (**Kafka**, **Kinesis**), and **MLOps** (**MLflow**, **Kubeflow**, **Vertex AI**). **FedRAMP High** authorized ML services remain underutilized due to **data labeling**, **model governance**, and **explainability** gaps.

items: **Model cards** and **bias audits** satisfy **OMB M-24-10** AI governance

blocks.text: Finding 5 · Cybersecurity & Compliance Automation

Manual **RMF** processes, spreadsheet-based **POA&M** tracking, and point-in-time assessments create **compliance debt**. Automation opportunities: **OSCAL** (**Open Security Controls Assessment Language**) for **machine-readable SSPs**, **continuous control monitoring** (**CCM**), **automated evidence collection**, and **risk scoring** via **FAIR** model.
Finding 6 · Accessibility & Citizen Experience Mandate

**21st Century IDEA** and **OMB M-23-22** require **Section 508** conformance, **WCAG 2.1 AA**, **plain language**, **mobile responsiveness**, and **user research** for all public-facing systems. Most legacy portals fail **automated** (**axe-core**, **Lighthouse**) and **manual** testing (screen readers: **NVDA**, **JAWS**, **VoiceOver**).

The scope of this engagement encompasses the full software development lifecycle (SDLC) and IT service management (ITSM) continuum for the Issuing Agency's application portfolio, infrastructure, and data estate. OrbitAvanya will serve as the single accountable prime integrator, delivering: (1) **Application Development & Modernization** — greenfield development, legacy refactoring, API enablement, and microservices decomposition using **Domain-Driven Design (DDD)**; (2) **Cloud Platform Engineering** — **AWS GovCloud** landing zone operations, **IaC** governance, **FinOps**, and **multi-cloud** (**Azure Government**) interoperability; (3) **DevSecOps & cATO Enablement** — end-to-end pipeline automation, **policy-as-code**, **continuous compliance**, and **RMF** acceleration; (4) **Data Engineering & AI/ML Platform** — **Lakehouse** architecture, **real-time analytics**, **MLOps**, and **generative AI** prototypes; (5) **Cybersecurity & Compliance Operations** — **SOC** services, **vulnerability management**, **OSCAL** automation, and **A&A** support; (6) **UX/UI & Accessibility** — **USWDS**-aligned design, **Section 508** conformance, and **human-centered design**; (7) **Program Management & Governance** — **SAFe 6.0**, **EVM**, **ITIL 4**, **risk management**, and **stakeholder communication**. All services will be delivered under a **firm-fixed-price (FFP)** / **time-and-materials (T&M)** hybrid CLIN structure with defined **SLAs**, **KPIs**, and **incentive fees** tied to mission outcomes.

blocks.text: OrbitAvanya's technical approach is founded on three pillars: **Mission-Aligned Architecture**, **Automated Compliance**, and **Measurable Velocity**. We implement a **modular monolith to microservices** evolution strategy using **Domain-Driven Design (DDD)** to identify **bounded contexts**, then apply the **Strangler Fig** pattern with **feature flags** (LaunchDarkly/Unleash) for zero-downtime cutover. Our **cloud-native platform** is built on **AWS GovCloud** with a **multi-account landing zone** (Management, Log Archive, Security, Shared Services, Workloads) governed by **AWS Control Tower**, **Organizations**, and **Service Control Policies (SCPs)** enforcing **preventive guardrails** (e.g., deny public S3, enforce encryption, require IMDSv2). **Infrastructure as Code** uses **Terraform** with **Terragrunt** for DRY modules, **Terratest** for unit/integration testing, and **Atlantis** for PR-driven plan/apply workflows. The **Kubernetes platform** runs on **EKS** with **managed node groups** (Bottlerocket AMIs), **Istio** for **mTLS**, **traffic splitting**, and **observability** (Kiali, Jaeger, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki), **ArgoCD** for **GitOps** (App of Apps pattern), **Kyverno** for **policy-as-code** (Pod Security Standards, Network Policies, Image Verification via **Cosign/Sigstore**), and **External Secrets Operator** integrating **AWS Secrets Manager** and **Parameter Store**. The **DevSecOps pipeline** (GitLab CI/CD) executes in **stages**: **Code Quality** (SonarQube, ESLint, Hadolint), **Security** (Semgrep/CodeQL SAST, Trivy container/fs, Grype SBOM, TruffleHog secrets, Checkov IaC, OPA policy), **Build** (Docker Buildx, Cosign sign, Syft SBOM), **Deploy** (ArgoCD sync to dev/stage/prod with **Canary** via Istio), **Test** (Postman/Newman contract, Playwright e2e, k6 load, axe-core accessibility), **Compliance** (Trestle OSCAL evidence generation, OpenSCAP STIG scan). **Continuous ATO** is achieved by mapping each **NIST 800-53 Rev. 5** control to **automated checks** (config, code, pipeline, runtime) with evidence continuously collected into **OSCAL** components (SSP, SAR, POA&M) via **ComplianceTrestle**, enabling **daily** compliance posture dashboards. The **Data Lakehouse** uses **S3** with **Delta Lake** (ACID, time travel, schema enforcement) and **Apache Iceberg** (multi-engine, partition evolution) registered in **AWS Glue Data Catalog** with **Lake Formation** fine-grained access control. **DBT** models (staging, intermediate, marts) enforce **data contracts** (Great Expectations) and **lineage** (DataHub). **Streaming** via **MSK** (Kafka) with **Schema Registry** (Avro/Protobuf) feeds **real-time dashboards** (Grafana) and **ML feature stores** (Feast). **MLOps** leverages **SageMaker Pipelines** or **Kubeflow** on EKS with **MLflow** tracking, **Evidently** drift monitoring, and **Model Cards** (Hugging Face format). **Generative AI** prototypes use **Bedrock** (Claude 3, Titan) or **SageMaker JumpStart** (Llama 3, Mistral) with **RAG** (LangChain, pgvector, hybrid search) and **Guardrails** (NeMo Guardrails, PII detection). **Accessibility** is embedded via **USWDS 3.0** React component library (Storybook, Chromatic visual regression), **axe-core** in CI, **Lighthouse CI** budgets, and **quarterly manual audits** with **assistive technology users**. **Program execution** follows **SAFe 6.0** with **2-week sprints**, **10-week PIs**, **PI Planning** (in-person/virtual), **ART Sync**, **System Demo**, **Inspect & Adapt**. **EVM** uses **Jira Align** with **0/100** or **50/50** earning rules, **baseline** at PI start, **monthly** CPR (Contract Performance Report) delivery. **DORA metrics** (Deployment Frequency, Lead Time, MTTR, Change Failure Rate) are tracked via **GitLab Value Stream Analytics** and reported quarterly. **Change Management** follows **ITIL 4** with **normal/standard/emergency** changes, **CAB** for major releases, **automated approval** for standard changes via **ServiceNow** integration with **ArgoCD**.
Core Capabilities

OrbitAvanya proposes a **hybrid CLIN structure** combining **Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP)** for well-defined mobilization, platform standup, and deliverable-based milestones (Phases 1-5) with **Time-and-Materials (T&M)** for steady-state operations, emergent requirements, and Level of Effort (LOE) support (Phase 6+). This approach provides **cost certainty** for the Agency during the critical standup period while preserving **flexibility** for evolving mission needs. Pricing is built on **fully burdened labor rates** compliant with **FAR 31.2** and **CAS**, using **DCAA-approved** forward pricing rates. **Incentive fees** (CPIF) are proposed for Phase 3-5 milestone acceleration and DORA metric improvement targets. **Travel/ODCs** are estimated per **FAR 31.205-46**. A detailed **Basis of Estimate (BOE)** with **WBS mapping**, **labor categories**, **hours**, **rates**, and **assumptions** will be submitted with the cost volume.
